records.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, authorization explicitly allows any attendee of the booking to add guests: `const isAttendee = !!booking.attendees.find((attendee) => attendee.email === user.email);` and the permission check only forbids when **none** of `isTeamAdminOrOwner`, `isOrganizer`, or `isAttendee` are true (`if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN;`). This means any existing attendee can call `addGuests` and append more attendees. Additionally, the input schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` defines `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no `.max(...)` or other

records.issue_text: replyTo header in organizer-add-guests-email grows unboundedly with attendee count across repeated add-guests operations, potentially exceeding SMTP header limits and causing email rejection
records.rationale: In `packages/emails/templates/organizer-add-guests-email.ts`, the new organizer email sets `replyTo: [this.calEvent.organizer.email, ...this.calEvent.attendees.map(({ email }) => email)]`, which scales linearly with the total attendee count.
